name: facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontexts/downstream/insseg/datasets/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.create_infsampler: create an InfSampler instance to infinitely sample dataset indices with optional shuffling
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.create_distributed_infsampler: create a DistributedInfSampler to partition infinite sampling across distributed training replicas and ranks
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.reset_permutation_infsampler: reset the permutation of an InfSampler to generate a fresh random ordering of indices
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.use_infsampler_next: use the next method of InfSampler to get the next dataset index auto-resetting when exhausted
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.use_distributed_infsampler_next: use the next method of DistributedInfSampler to get the next index for the current rank

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.create_voxelization_dataset: create a VoxelizationDataset subclass to load and voxelize RGB point clouds with data augmentation for 3D scene segmentation
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.create_temporal_dataset: create a TemporalVoxelizationDataset to load sequences of point clouds with configurable temporal dilation and sequence length
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.initialize_data_loader: build a PyTorch DataLoader with augmentation transforms, caching, and optional infinite sampling for training or evaluation
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.convert_dataset_phase: convert between DatasetPhase enum values and string representations for train, val, test, and debug phases
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.extract_instance_info: compute instance bounding boxes, centers, and occupancy counts from point cloud coordinates and instance ID arrays

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.create_scannet_voxelization_dataset: create a ScannetVoxelizationDataset instance with config, transforms, augmentation, and dataset phase for 3D scene segmentation
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.load_scannet_pointcloud_data: load pointcloud coordinates, features, semantic labels, and instance labels from a ScanNet .pth file by index
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.augment_pointcloud_location_feature: augment a pointcloud tensor by appending a scaled location feature column at the specified LOCFEAT_IDX position
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.save_scannet_prediction: save voxel grid predictions mapped back to original pointcloud space as a torch file for ScanNet evaluation submission
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.get_scannet_output_id: get the room ID string from a data path by extracting the first two underscore-separated segments of the filename

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.create_stanford_dataset: create a StanfordArea5Dataset instance with config, transforms, and augmentation for 3D point cloud segmentation
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.run_pointcloud_evaluation: run full pointcloud evaluation on Stanford dataset predictions using test_pointcloud with a prediction directory
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.load_ply_pointcloud: load a PLY point cloud file returning coordinates, RGB features, and semantic labels via load_ply
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.load_torch_pointcloud: load a preprocessed Torch point cloud file returning coordinates, features, labels, and instances via load_data
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.augment_coords_to_feats: augment point cloud features by concatenating normalized centered coordinates to existing feature vectors

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.load_camera_extrinsics: load camera extrinsics from a text file and return a 4x4 numpy matrix
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.load_camera_intrinsics: load camera intrinsics from a text file and return focal length, principal point, and baseline
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.load_depth_map: load a SYNTHIA depth map PNG file and return a numpy array of depth values in centimeters
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.load_semantic_labels: load ground truth semantic segmentation labels from a PNG file with 16 class IDs
